content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 20 vacancies distributed across various departments and categories as follows:

rows.qualification: For Medical Candidates: A recognized MBBS degree & must have completed one year of compulsory rotatory internship.ORFor Non-Medical Candidates: Postgraduate qualification e.g. Master’s degree in the discipline / allied subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment entitles the appointee to a remuneration of ₹ 15,600-39,100 + ₹ 5,400 (Grade Pay) + NPA plus other usual allowance or revised pay scale as per 7th CPC as applicable (Level – 10 of the Matrix, entry pay of ₹ 56,100/- PM plus usual allowances). Non-Practising Allowance (NPA) is applicable for medical candidates only. The appointment is on a contract basis for an initial period of 12 months under the Central Residency Scheme and will not vest any right to claim permanent absorption.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official AIIMS, Jodhpur website at www.aiimsjodhpur.edu.in . Navigate to the online registration link for the Tutor / Demonstrator recruitment starting from 12th October, 2026. Complete the online application form with required personal and educational details for only one department. Submit the online application on or before the last date of 2nd November, 2026 (17:00 Hrs.). Do not send hard copies of the online application or any documents by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.) Address Proof Certificate showing Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / 10th Certificate) Class 10th & 12th Marksheet and Certificates Qualifying degree marksheets and degree certificates (MBBS/B.Sc./M.Sc.) Attempt and Internship Completion Certificate Registration with Medical Council of India / State Medical Council Experience Certificate (if applicable) FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduates) Reservation category Certificate (OBC / SC / ST / PH) where applicable, with OBC certificate issued within one year belonging to the non-creamy layer of the Central List No Objection Certificate (NOC) for candidates working in Government Institutions Publications (if any)

faq.question: Q1. Is this AIIMS Jodhpur appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis for an initial period of 12 months under the Govt. of India's Residency Scheme and does not vest any right to claim permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes, appointees receive remuneration as per the pay scale with usual allowances admissible under rules, plus Non-Practising Allowance (NPA) specifically applicable for medical candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What relaxations are provided in the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit of 30 years is relaxable by up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, and up to 10 years for PwBD General candidates, 13 years for PwBD OBC candidates, and 15 years for PwBD SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for selection?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates will be done in a 1:6 ratio, and a written examination or interview will be conducted depending upon the number of applications received.

faq.question: Q5. Can a candidate apply for more than one department?
faq.answer: No, a candidate can apply in only one department. Filling more than one application against the seat, department, or subject will result in the cancellation of all such applications.
